items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed for fleet-wide clearance; blocked for public exposure and security-sensitive releases; conditional for ordinary reversible growth. Evidence: fleet-doctor has no run or control results; operations deploy-health, uptime, and error sweeps have no results; authentication and access boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release provenance and approvals, dependency and supply-chain controls, data exposure, monitoring, incident response, complete TLS posture, and security.txt/disclosure readiness remain unverified. No certificates are reported expiring within 30 days, but this does not establish complete TLS coverage. Compliance is a technical baseline only: 35 pass, 14 fail, and 10 unknown. Retained worker and reviewer failures are containment signals, not evidence of compromise. Exact decision: preserve private launch gates, permit only bounded reversible growth that retains existing consent, disclosures, data handling, and claims boundaries, and continue existing read-only security evidence work. Do not create new production work, requeue failures, access credentials or private containers, modify permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, or conduct external outreach.

Continue the existing bounded read-only security evidence matrix and failed-work containment. Record dated evidence, owners, affected scope, explicit unknowns, severity, and release implications for access boundaries, secrets, runtime isolation, release provenance, dependency controls, TLS, data flows, monitoring, incident readiness, and disclosure readiness. Do not create duplicate telemetry requests or new production work.
